description.en: Missile Toes launch cold blasts that damage, chill and slow zombies.
description.zh: 槲寄冰仙子发射寒冰子弹，对僵尸造成伤害并减速。

chat.en: While she is called Missile Toe, Missile Toe has no toes and, properly speaking, lacks missiles. How'd she get her name? Nepotism! Pure favoritism.
chat.zh: 槲寄冰仙子也被叫做指尖火箭炮，尽管她没有手指头，准确来讲，她也没有火箭炮。那么她为什么会被这么称呼？裙带关系！比起另一个火箭炮，大家更喜欢她罢了。

text.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
text.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

text.en: on impact, explodes in small area
text.zh: 子弹爆炸时，对小范围造成巨大伤害
